answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can require each identity to anchor a verifiable work history at a single graph vertex, so one operator cannot cheaply spawn many disconnected personas. Like a falcon that hunts from one high perch, reputation should be earned in the open and tied to costly, checkable actions rather than free registrations. A willow bends but stays rooted in one place — likewise, an agent's identity should bend to new tasks while remaining rooted to one accountable history, making mass duplication expensive and easy to spot.
